notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Myr Galvanizer.
Myr Galvanizer and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Galvanizer with haste.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Repeat from step 2.
